backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing and returning contact form submissions using a List and timestamping each entry.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to involved files, components, and test IDs for build planning.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file and component in the React app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variable definitions and global styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app with page metadata for SEO.
frontend/PUBLISHING.md: Publishing guide outlining asset checks, component references, config validation, and steps for building and deploying to the IC.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component composing all site sections, theme provider, WhatsApp CTA, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section providing company description, features, and contact CTAs with WhatsApp and scroll helpers.
frontend/src/components/Certificates.tsx: Certificates section showing the Udyam Registration certificate with preview, details, and view/download actions.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: Renders a contact section with a form, quick contact buttons, and contact info cards using local state and mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/electrician-anim: SVG scene showing an emergency repair animation with beacon, sparks, and toolbox, respecting reduced-motion preference.
SVG animation of an MCB switch toggling on/off periodically or remaining static when reduced motion is enabled.
SVG scene rendering panel wiring with animated wire flow and spark effects, respecting reduced-motion mode.
SVG scene showing a switch board being installed with animated screws and screwdriver, supporting reduced-motion.
SVG scene of a voltage tester checking a socket with probe movement and LED/voltage display animations.
frontend/src/components/ElectricianWorkA: Displays a grid of electrician work animations or static media, with reduced‑motion support and descriptive titles.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Shows floating call and WhatsApp buttons that appear after scrolling, opening phone or chat links.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Provides footer with company info, quick navigation links, contact details, and a small credit section.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements a sticky header with scroll effects, contact bar, navigation links, mobile menu, and WhatsApp/phone actions.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Renders the hero section with animated/static background media, AMC highlight, branding, and CTAs for WhatsApp and contact.
frontend/src/components/Products.tsx: Defines a product list with formatted pricing and renders product cards including images, descriptions, and WhatsApp/contact actions.
frontend/src/components/ReducedMotionMed: Displays either an animated or static image depending on the user's reduced-motion preference.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Renders core and additional service cards with images, descriptions, and WhatsApp/contact triggers.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Displays customer testimonials with names, locations, reviews, and star ratings using card components.
frontend/src/components/WorkVideo.tsx: Implements a canvas-based animated montage viewer with play controls, speed selection, and recording support.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and updates a backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, login, logout, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useMontagePlayer.ts: Hook controlling slideshow-style image progression with play, pause, restart, and speed adjustment.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Hook returning whether the user prefers reduced motion via a media query listener.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for submitting contact forms and fetching contact submissions via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style definitions including color variables, dark mode, animations, and layout utilities.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports business branding constants and a dynamic header tagline.
frontend/src/lib/montageRecorder.ts: Provides functions to check recording support and generate a WebM video montage by animating and crossfading images on a canvas.
frontend/src/lib/scroll.ts: Contains utilities for smooth scrolling to page sections while accounting for a dynamic fixed header height.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp Business chat URLs with optional preset messages for the given business number.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app root and wraps it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme extensions, colors, plugins, container settings, and custom keyframes.
project_state.json: Holds project metadata, requirements, image specifications, and feature definitions for the electrical services website.
